workspaces.notes:
The Skylus AlmaLinux 9 Workspace requires libseccomp => 2.5.3 to run.

This can be checked by running runc --version

If you still want to run AlmaLinux 9 but do not have the minimum required libseccomp version, it can be run in an unsecure manner by adding: {"security_opt":["seccomp=unconfined"]} to the Docker Run Config Override (JSON) setting above.

NOTE: This will run the Workspace without the docker seccomp sandbox and will significantly reduce the amount of protection that Skylus Workspaces can provide.

workspaces.notes:
The Redroid Workspace is experimental.
It leverages skylus's DinD (Docker in Docker) image, and automates utilizing Redroid and scrcpy projects.

This image requires the "binder_linux" host level kernel modules installed and enabled.  See [Redroid Docs](https://github.com/remote-android/redroid-doc?tab=readme-ov-file#getting-started) for more details.

## Example for installing binder_linux on Ubuntu 22.04 LTS host
```
sudo apt install linux-modules-extra-`uname -r`
sudo modprobe binder_linux devices="binder,hwbinder,vndbinder"
```

The left ALT key is mapped as the hotkey for scrcpy

- Alt+R - rotate the android device
- Alt+F - fullscreen the android device
- Alt+Up/Alt+Down - Increase the volume of the device

See [scrcpy docs](https://github.com/Genymobile/scrcpy) for more details.

Various functionality within the image can be adjust by altering the environment variables as described in the [Dockerhub Registry](https://hub.docker.com/r/harbor.local/skylus-workspaces/redroid)
